plugins.name: PlayStation game files
plugins.author: GuardianSoul
plugins.description: Makes the game files (.json) for the PlayStation core: one entry per multi-disc game with every disc in it and one shared memory card, cue-only game files for cores from 0.5.3, LibCrypt .sbi files, and CHD images extracted safely. Put your games in Assets/playstation/common/, each in its own folder.
